attestations.text: HO Ch'iu-t'ao 何秋濤 (T. 巨源, 願船), 1824–1862; June 30, scholar and historian, was a native of Kuang-tsê, Fukien. At the age of twenty (sui) he became a chü-jên (1843) and in the following year a chin-shih.
